import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/cameras.csv')

# Set the style of the visualization
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a scatter plot to show the relationship between price and megapixels, colored by sensor type
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
scatter_plot = sns.scatterplot(
    data=data, 
    x='megapixels', 
    y='price_usd', 
    hue='sensor_type', 
    style='has_video_4k', 
    palette='deep', 
    s=100, 
    alpha=0.7
)

# Add axis labels and a title
scatter_plot.set_title('Camera Price vs. Megapixels by Sensor Type', fontsize=16)
scatter_plot.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=14)
scatter_plot.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=14)

# Add a legend
scatter_plot.legend(title='Sensor Type & 4K Video', title_fontsize='13', fontsize='11', loc='upper left', bbox_to_anchor=(1, 1))

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
